title: Android Wear IOB not available
body:
Hello,

I'm using xDrip on my phone and also my Android Wear (Huawei Smartwatch 2) Device. As I do not have a pump/loop, IoB is a very important value for me. In xDrip, this value is shown (very prominent), but is there any way to get it on my Watchface? 
I now have informations about my estimated A1c etc as a toast message, but I haven't found a way to get my current IoB!

Cheers,
Bernhard

comments.body: I have changed to AAPS now - especially the watchface is much more stable (including connection, availablity etc) and IoB is available. It's a little bit an overkill to run AAPS just because of the watchface, but it is worth it!

@BernhardRo Would you please close this issue as you don't seem to be having the problem any longer.
Thanks
